components.name: ESP32-WROOM-32D
components.description:
Wi-Fi + BT + BLE MCU module with dual Xtensa 32-bit LX6 cores up to 240 MHz, 4MB Flash.

### Specifications
- **CPU**: Dual-core 32-bit LX6 @ 240MHz
- **RAM**: 520 KB SRAM
- **Flash**: 4 MB SPI Flash
- **Wireless**: 802.11 b/g/n + BT 4.2 BR/EDR/BLE

components.name: STM32F401RE
components.description:
High-performance ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit MCU with FPU, 84 MHz, 512 KB Flash, 96 KB SRAM.

### Key Features
- 84 MHz maximum frequency
- 512 Kbytes of Flash memory
- 96 Kbytes of SRAM
- USB 2.0 OTG FS

components.name: BME280 Digital Sensor
components.description:
Combined digital humidity, pressure and temperature sensor based on proven sensing principles.

### Parameters
- Temperature range: -40 to +85 °C
- Pressure range: 300 to 1100 hPa
- Humidity range: 0 to 100% RH
- Interface: I2C and SPI

components.name: LM7805 Linear Regulator
components.description:
Positive 3-terminal voltage regulator with 5V fixed output and 1.5A current capability.

### Specifications
- Output Voltage: 5.0 V
- Max Output Current: 1.5 A
- Package: TO-220
- Thermal Overload Protection: Built-in

components.name: MPU-6050 6-DoF IMU
components.description:
6-axis MotionTracking device combining a 3-axis gyroscope and a 3-axis accelerometer on a single silicon die with Digital Motion Processor (DMP).

### Characteristics
- I2C digital output
- 16-bit ADCs on all axes
- User-programmable full scale ranges

components.name: 10k Resistor 0805 1%
components.description: Surface mount thick film chip resistor 10k ohm 1% 1/8W 0805 SMD.

components.name: 100nF Ceramic Capacitor 0805
components.description: Multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) 0.1uF 50V X7R 10% 0805 SMD decoupling capacitor.
